title: The AI interview tell
style: swiss playful light, yellow accent, funny

lines: Job interview. *Question one.* Tell me about yourself.

bubbles.text: Certainly. I am a results-driven synergy champion.

lines: The candidate pauses. Fills the silence. Then answers like a *robot* wrote it.
Recruiters notice. A UK survey found *ninety two percent* of graduate employers suspected or confirmed misconduct.
One recruiter says the tells are *pauses*, filler phrases, and unnaturally formal answers.
So use AI to *practice*, not to answer.

facts.claim: 92% of graduate employers suspected or confirmed applicant misconduct

post.title: The AI interview tell (recruiters notice)
post.tiktok_caption: POV: the interview where the answers sound like a robot wrote them. Recruiters say they notice. #jobinterview #AI #fyp
post.yt_caption: Skit based on a real UK survey: 92% of graduate employers suspected or confirmed applicant misconduct. Use AI to practice, not to answer.
post.pinned_comment: The dialogue is a skit. The 92% figure is from the Institute of Student Employers survey (suspected or confirmed misconduct of all kinds, not only AI). The tells are from one recruiter quoted by the Guardian.

sources.name: HR Review, ISE Student Recruitment Survey 2026
